patterns.note: Full-bleed video or image backgrounds are used for hero sections and prominent content blocks, often with text overlaid directly on the visual.
A strong typographic hierarchy is established with oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings for section titles, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif body text.

The primary palette is monochromatic (black, white, and various grays), with vibrant accent colors introduced contextually within content (e.g., a deep red for a CTA, warm brown from a video background).

A large, full-bleed video hero section scrolls out of view to reveal subsequent content. A prominent, oversized brand mark (B/D) appears fixed in the viewport for a brief period after the hero, then scrolls away with the content.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, many featuring large background visuals (videos or images) that define the section's aesthetic.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero (detected: video-hero) plays on loop as the initial viewport. As the user scrolls, this hero section scrolls out of view, revealing subsequent content sections that animate into place from the bottom. A large, fixed brand mark is temporarily displayed after the hero, creating a strong brand moment before it too scrolls off-screen. The main navigation remains sticky at the top throughout the scroll.

Full-bleed background videos or images are used for hero and key content sections, often with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text readability. Content is structured in clean, often asymmetric grids for showcasing work, news, and team members.
A full-screen modal overlay can be triggered, presenting content (e.g., a client's app page) while subtly dimming the background page content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (up to ~6x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, paired with legible, regular-weight sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in hero and section titles, balanced in content grids with generous vertical separation between sections.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed, high-quality video backgrounds for hero and key content sections, combined with a bold, almost brutalist typographic approach for section titles and a large, temporary fixed brand mark (B/D) that appears after the hero, creates a powerful and memorable brand experience.
